display_long_description:
**Garden Tend** is your new, magical gardening experience. Grow a collection of curious, moody, and beautiful plants that need more than just water, they need you!

# 🌱 Watch Life Unfold
Witness every leaf unfurl & flower bloom in real-time. Inspired by reality, our artists hand-crafted every frame of growth to make your plants feel truly alive.
[media]

#  🧩  Blooms Take Time, Patience is the Best Fertilizer
Our core belief is that every plant experience should spark joy. No plants die in **Garden Tend**, they just might be moodier, shy, or extra demanding!
[media]


# 👋 Your World, Your Hands
No controllers needed. Using just your hands, place virtual pots right on your real coffee table or bookshelf.
[media]


# 🎶 Find Your Vibe
Customize your sanctuary with hand-painted backgrounds and a "soundbath" soundtrack to set the right mood.
[media]


# 🌼Start Your Garden for Free
Dip your toes in the soil for free, featuring 5 unique plants and a collection of cozy decor.
[media]


# 🌺 Ready to grow more?
The **Founder's Collection** is available for those who want the full botanical experience: unlocking 10+ rare plants, new backgrounds, music, and exclusive designer pots.

# Transform your world, one plant at a time.
🪴
